threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it ‘the Overground’ instead of ‘the East London Line’ – it’s a classic rookie mistake.
Caught a guy on the 59 last night singing along to his headphones, totally oblivious to the bemused crowd. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a neighbor feeding pigeons while another was painting a mural of a cat on their garage door—it felt like the heart of Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous karaoke party at 2 AM in an open courtyard. And it’s not even that unusual.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a true local when they still call Valencia 'the street with the good burritos' instead of 'Valencia Street.' It’s a vibe.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Today, I watched a guy with a guitar serenade a dog on the 19-Polk. The pup seemed to love it more than half the passengers.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists assume every Plaça is for lounging, but the locals know they’re just as likely to be host to a protest or spontaneous concert.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their reluctance to embrace the 11am coffee break; the locals already have their second espresso by then.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can always spot a newcomer by how they still try to hail a cab instead of just ordering an Uber. Classic rookie mistake.
Saw a couple arguing over who gets the last of the chicken shop's salt. They ended up sharing it, but the bus driver looked like he wished he could mute them.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Caught a bus at 2 AM with a guy singing opera. The driver just nodded along. That's when I knew this place has a rhythm all its own.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find spontaneous open-air karaoke in the streets on a Saturday night, complete with a crowd of cheering strangers.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows that the best burritos come from the hole-in-the-wall spots, not the trendy chains, especially after a late-night BART delay.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo hop off the 19 and start directing traffic like a conductor. Only in the Tenderloin does Muni turn into a performance art.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's vibrant squares are just for selfies, but they're actually filled with locals sipping café and catching up on gossip.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewildered looks at El Corte Inglés prices – local shoppers have mastered the art of the discounts and sales.
